g.text: Break the checkout redesign into tasks
tandem keys (planners = left column, implementers = right column)
Tabs F3 previous agent in this column
F4 next agent in this column
Status F5 focus the status window
Agents F9 close the focused agent (asks first)
Quit F10 exit menu: save and exit, detach, update tandem, kill
Agents F11 restart an exited agent
Layout F12 resize mode: arrows resize the focused pane, = resets, Enter exits
Mouse click a pane to focus it; drag a border to resize; scroll wheel scrolls
Resize F12 then arrows (←→ 5 columns, ↑↓ 2 rows) on the focused pane; = resets; Enter exits
Detach your agents keep running; run `tandem` again to re-attach
↑↓ move · Enter answer · 1-9 pick option · Ctrl+S send · Esc cancel · w withdraw · g go to agent
F1 Help F2 New agent F3 Prev F4 Next F5 Status F6 Queries F7 Planners F8 Implementers F9 Close F10 Quit F11 Restart F12 Resize
